verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management platform covering contract creation, signing, storage, workflows and related APIs and webhooks. Obtaining a federal EIN is an incorporation or tax-registration service, which is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Ironclad offering incorporation or EIN filing; even the early startup-oriented community posts concern contract templates for contractors.

support.subject: As a founder, I can obtain a federal EIN for my new company through the platform
